title: D2 versioned structured handoff
description: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema for the D2 versioned structured handoff envelope (plan item D2, issue #8). Design-only draft: no runtime parser, prompt change, or adoption claim relies on this document. The envelope preserves the five-field prose handoff (Outcome, Files, Verification, Risks, Follow-up) and adds strictly validated fields for evidence, assumptions, artifact references, and review state. Version is constrained to 1.

version.description: Envelope schema version, constrained to 1 for this draft. Future incompatible changes must bump the version and document migration.

taskId.description: Stable identifier for the task this handoff reports on, used to correlate the handoff across hops.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the task when the handoff was written. 'completed' may coexist with not-run verification entries when those checks do not apply to the delivered change.

outcome.description: Maps to the prose field 'Outcome: what was achieved or discovered'.

facts.description: Established facts, each with a statement and at least one evidence reference.

assumptions.description: Explicitly labeled assumptions with a verification status and evidence references. Evidence may be empty while an assumption is Unverified.

filesRead.description: Files read, with the scope of each read. Part of the prose 'Files' field.

filesChanged.description: Files changed, with the scope of each change. Part of the prose 'Files' field.

verification.description: Commands run and their results. Maps to the prose 'Verification' field. Honest states not-run, blocked, fail, and pass are supported.

risks.description: Known uncertainty or regression risk, each with a severity. Maps to the prose 'Risks' field.

followUp.description: The next concrete action. Maps to the prose 'Follow-up' field.

artifactRefs.description: Path-safe references to stored artifacts instead of raw transcripts. kind=file references must be relative repository paths; kind=url references must be https URLs.

reviewState.description: Review workflow state of this handoff.

relativeRepoPath.description: Relative repository path. No leading '/', no '.'/'..' path segments, no '://' scheme prefix, no quotes or control characters; names with spaces or dots are allowed.

evidenceRef.description: A reference to evidence: a relative repository path (optionally with a #anchor such as #L19-25) or an https URL. Strings containing '://' must be https URLs.

evidence.description: At least one reference supporting the statement.

id.description: Stable identifier for the assumption so downstream hops can track its verification.

status.description: Current verification status of the assumption.

evidence.description: References supporting the stated status; intentionally allowed to be empty while Unverified.

path.description: Relative repository path. Absolute paths, '.'/'..' path segments, '://' scheme prefixes, quotes, and control characters are rejected; names containing spaces or dots are allowed.

scope.description: What the file was read for, or what change was made to it.

command.description: The command or check that was run.

status.description: Honest outcome: not-run when the check was intentionally skipped, blocked when it could not run, fail or pass when it ran.

result.description: Observed result; for not-run, state why the check was not run.

statement.description: The known uncertainty or regression risk.

kind.description: file = relative repository path; url = https URL.

reference.description: The artifact location, constrained by kind: a relative repository path for file, an https URL for url.
